issues.title: After upgrading Nodemailer from 10.3.1 to 10.5.0, every send fails with a connection timeout

latest_release.name: v10.5.0
latest_release.body:
## [10.5.0](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/compare/v10.4.1...v10.5.0) (2026-11-10)

<!-- release-notes:start -->

### Summary

Adds per-message cancellation to `sendMail()` with an AbortSignal, plus two encoding fixes: DKIM signatures for internationalized domains, and header text that looks like a broken encoded-word.

### Who should upgrade

- Anyone who signs with DKIM for a domain written with upper case or mapped non-ASCII characters (an upper case IDN label, or one holding a soft hyphen). The `d=` tag named a different domain than `From:`, so verification and DMARC alignment failed.
- Anyone who wants to cancel or time-limit a single send without closing the transport or pool.

### Highlights

- **AbortSignal per send:** `sendMail({ ..., signal })` on SMTP and pooled SMTP. An abort removes a queued message from the pool, or closes only the connection delivering it, and the send fails with an `AbortError` (code `EABORT`). Other transports honor a signal that is already aborted and otherwise ignore it. Note that an abort late in DATA does not prove the server did not accept the message, so do not treat `EABORT` as safe to retry blindly.
- **DKIM:** the `d=` domain is encoded with UTS-46 mapping, the same way as the address headers.
- **Header encoding:** plain text that a receiver would decode as an encoded-word without it being a valid one (such as `=?utf-8?Q?a b?=` across a space) is now encoded. A valid encoded-word is still passed through, so subjects that are already encoded are not encoded twice.
- **SMTP connection:** a supplied socket no longer connects, and TLS no longer starts, after the connection was closed.

<!-- release-notes:end -->


### Features

* **smtp:** support AbortSignal for individual sends ([#1911](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/issues/1911)) ([66387ed](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/commit/66387ed6f4bd26208b944b74b7329201ad77377b)), closes [#1910](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/issues/1910)


### Bug Fixes

* **dkim:** encode the d= domain the same way as the address headers ([#1908](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/issues/1908)) ([4ebf03f](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/commit/4ebf03fba33a96118c10afa340ce895a00549148))
* **mime-funcs:** encode header text that would be decoded as an invalid encoded word ([#1912](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/issues/1912)) ([7a7b942](https://github.com/nodemailer/nodemailer/commit/7a7b9427b632d8785190747ae2c62e88e77bc837))
